provenance_events.description: The 1803 runs 1971-1978 as the last Day-Date with a Plexi crystal and matte dial option. Vintage Day-Date collecting centres on the 1803 / 18038 / 18238 series — the watch Roger Moore and the 1970s "presidential" signal.

The Rolex Day-Date 1803 runs 1971-1978 as the last Day-Date with a Plexi crystal and matte dial option. Vintage Day-Date collecting centres on the 1803/18038/18238 series — a watch Roger Moore and 1970s Hong Kong magnates wore as the "presidential" signal.

narrative.story: The 1803 is the reference most people mean by vintage President: 36mm gold case, fluted bezel, pie-pan dial, and the non-quickset calibers 1555 and 1556. Its association with power is literal — Lyndon Johnson wore a Day-Date in office, and the President bracelet name attached to the model in that era. Long production and high volume keep entry prices reasonable for a solid-gold vintage Rolex.
narrative.collector_notes: The estimate covers yellow gold, a champagne dial, and a gold President bracelet. Other metals and strap configurations are separate. Check dial originality and bracelet wear. Non-quickset day and date is normal.
